metadata.name: Research implementation based on publicly documented criteria from AAOIFI (Shari'ah Standard No. 21)
metadata.source_title: AAOIFI Shari'ah Standards (English, 2015 printing) — Shari'ah Standard No. (21): Financial Paper (Shares and Bonds)
metadata.scope: Independent research implementation by Suhail of the share-dealing conditions in clause 3/4 of AAOIFI Shari'ah Standard No. 21, adapted to US SEC filings. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or licensed by AAOIFI, and not a statement of compliance with AAOIFI. Suhail assumptions are labelled on each criterion. Not applied: purification of prohibited income (3/4/6); continuous observation throughout the holding period (3/4/8), since Suhail screens the latest annual filing only; the asset-composition condition in 3/19 (outside clause 3/4); the intermediary and agency rules in 3/4/7.
metadata.notes: D-171. Clause locators refer to the English 2015 printing (pp. 562–565). Copyrighted source: only the link, edition, SHA-256 and Suhail's paraphrase with locators are stored; no source text or file is stored or served. Shariah-reviewer questions are listed in reviewer_questions; none is resolved by this draft.

version.changelog: Initial draft of an independent research implementation. Unpublished, unapproved and not production-enabled.
version.notes: D-171 draft. Market capitalisation is the latest stored month-end market cap (month-end close × shares outstanding), not the D-122 market value basis. Unknown when no market cap exists.

purification_treatment.label: Purification
purification_treatment.note: Suhail does not calculate purification amounts.

document.title: Shari'ah Standards (English) — includes Shari'ah Standard No. (21): Financial Paper (Shares and Bonds)
document.edition: English edition printed 2015 (Manama); SS 21 clause 3/4 on printed pp. 562–565

criteria.label: Prohibited primary business activity
criteria.definition: The company's primary activity must be permissible, and its stated objects must not include dealing in interest or prohibited goods. Suhail tests the classified primary activity against its existing prohibited-category list.
criteria.formula_text: Fail if the classified primary activity is in the prohibited list; unclassified is unknown.
criteria.treatment_rules: Suhail adaptation: reuses the existing prohibited categories, activity carry-forward, SIC mapping and analyst-override rules (D-132, D-157). Memorandum-of-association objects (3/4/1) are not read from filings; the classified primary activity stands in for them. Unclassified never passes.
criteria.edge_cases: Missing segments or an unclassified or tied primary activity requires review.
criteria.source_reference: AAOIFI SS 21, clauses 3/2, 3/4 (heading) and 3/4/1, pp. 562–563 (paraphrased); Suhail category list
criteria.notes: Category list is a Suhail interpretation pending Shariah review.

criteria.label: Interest-bearing debt / market capitalisation
criteria.definition: Interest-bearing borrowings, short- and long-term, must not exceed 30% of market capitalisation. A ratio exactly at 30% passes.
criteria.treatment_rules: Numerator is the existing SEC interest-bearing debt line (leases excluded, D-44). Denominator is the latest stored month-end market capitalisation (month-end close × shares outstanding), not the Al Rajhi market value basis. No market cap means unknown.
criteria.edge_cases: Unknown or non-positive market capitalisation blocks the calculation.
criteria.notes: Maximum 30%, no borderline margin. Reviewer question: point-in-time versus averaged market capitalisation.

criteria.label: Interest-bearing deposits and investments / market capitalisation
criteria.definition: Interest-taking deposits, short-, medium- or long-term, must not exceed 30% of market capitalisation. A ratio exactly at 30% passes.
criteria.formula_text: (cash including restricted cash + short-term investments + long-term investments) / market_cap × 100 ≤ 30
criteria.numerator_definition: Cash, short-term and long-term investments (balance sheet)
criteria.treatment_rules: Conservative Suhail assumption: the source names interest-taking deposits; SEC filings do not show which balances bear interest, so all cash and all short- and long-term investment balances are counted. Uses the validated balance-sheet evidence from the latest annual filing (D-155 context); unknown, never zero, when that evidence is incomplete.
criteria.edge_cases: Incomplete balance-sheet evidence is unknown. Financial institutions (SIC 6000–6299) have no prepared asset evidence and are unknown.
criteria.source_reference: AAOIFI SS 21, clause 3/4/3, p. 563 (paraphrased); Suhail conservative assumption
criteria.notes: Reviewer question: the English text refers to the market capitalisation of total equity; left unresolved.

criteria.label: Prohibited income / total revenue
criteria.definition: Income from prohibited components must not exceed 5% of total income. A ratio exactly at 5% passes.
criteria.formula_text: Prefer existing income evidence. Otherwise (cash + short-term securities + long-term securities) × annual_yield_assumption / total_revenue × 100 ≤ 5.
criteria.treatment_rules: Same precedence as Al Rajhi v1.1 (D-124, D-154): reported or analyst-resolved income first, then the Suhail upper-bound assumption, otherwise unknown. An excessive bound is unknown, not fail. Suhail adaptation: the source says total income; total revenue is used as the denominator.

suhail_upper_bound.explanation: Upper bound: a conservative assumption chosen by Suhail, not part of the AAOIFI standard. It is an estimate, not reported prohibited income or a guaranteed bound on actual income.

criteria.edge_cases: Unknown numerator requires review; unknown or non-positive revenue blocks calculation.
criteria.source_reference: AAOIFI SS 21, clause 3/4/4, p. 563 (paraphrased); D-154 Suhail upper-bound assumption, not part of the AAOIFI standard

not_applied: Continuous observation throughout the holding period (3/4/8)
Rules for intermediaries, agents and fund managers (3/4/7)
reviewer_questions: 3/4/3 refers to the market capitalisation of total equity; confirm the intended denominator.
3/4/3 names interest-taking deposits; Suhail counts all cash and investments. Confirm or narrow.
3/4/4 uses total income; Suhail uses total revenue. Confirm.
Point-in-time (latest month-end) versus averaged market capitalisation for 3/4/2 and 3/4/3.
Whether 3/19 (tangible assets at least 30% of total assets) should be added.
The prohibited-category list reused from the Al Rajhi adaptation (includes conventional media, excludes weapons).
